integrity: The proof reconstructs the common-neighbor characterization, the universal-vertex threshold, the exact reduction to a bounded \(K_{2,4}\)-free remainder, the component optimization, the disconnected case, and the boundary orders. The initiating arXiv paper and the closest public \(K_{2,4}\) result were inspected at statement and proof level. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to cographs and ordinary-subgraph avoidance of \(K_{2,5}\). The finite verifier stress-tests the local six-vertex reduction, the integer optimization through order 500, and constructions through order 40; it is not a substitute for the all-order analytic proof. A finite dynamic-programming table associated with the initiating paper may overlap individual small values without implying the closed formula or extremal classification.
title: Exact \(K_{2,5}\)-free Turán number for cographs
